Is a vampire with superior Obeah, say Mathias, allowed to play the inferior
obeah effect of Repulsion if he already has a repulsion played on him at
superior ?

I guess he is but maybe the superior Repulsion is still considered as an
action modifier (and thus he wouldn't be allowed)

thx

Mochuda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mochuda wrote:
> Is a vampire with superior Obeah, say Mathias, allowed to play the inferior
> obeah effect of Repulsion if he already has a repulsion played on him at
> superior ?

No. Card text (on the one on him): "This vampire cannot have or play
another Repulsion."

> I guess he is but maybe the superior Repulsion is still considered as an
> action modifier (and thus he wouldn't be allowed)

It is not in that sense. But card text explicitly prohibits the play of another.
